answer: Let the vine decide who climbs: each identity starts as a bare shoot and grows one terrace of trust per epoch of settled work, a trellis rung that is signed by whoever it served. Rungs cannot be transferred, bought or copied, and a rung signed twice for the same work is rejected outright. A clone must grow all of its own rungs from the ground, paying a full season of real tasks for every fake, while the honest vine has been climbing since planting. The garden is public: any observer can see which vine was planted yesterday and which has been bearing fruit for months.
